column1: # Source repos this repo is permitted to call a reusable workflow from.
# EMPTY BY DEFAULT, AND THAT IS THE POINT. A cross-repo reusable-workflow call
# whose source cannot be resolved fails the calling workflow at STARTUP, which
# produces a run with ZERO jobs and therefore ZERO check-runs. The gate is not
# red, it is ABSENT, and absent is indistinguishable from passing on the PR
# merge box and to every branch-protection rule.
# CM051 shipped exactly that: enforce-ledger-write.yml called
# andygmassey/HR015-Gaming-PC, which is PRIVATE with actions access_level
# "none", so run 32220337769 on PR #493 finished with conclusion=failure,
# 0 jobs and 0 check-runs. Nobody saw it.
# BEFORE ADDING A ROW: measure, do not assume.
#   gh api repos/<owner>/<repo> --jq .private          # must be false
# allowlisted repo whenever a token is present, and fails the row if the repo
# is private -- the allowlist is a declaration, never the evidence.
